summary: Tested iteration-13 change requests on preview (API + UI). WORKING: (1) Primary/Secondary/Pro workbench is one continuous report: no 'Page x of N', status bar shows scroll-progress 'N% reviewed', dashed page-breaks (Primary 10, Secondary 20, Pro 30). Trial still has 'Page 1 of 1'. (2) Glossary hint in the workbench: clicking a part shows 'Glossary tip: in this part, write “X” as “Y”…'. The terms fit the text (e.g. Secondary p58_03 'In the light of'). The 40 s gap works: no new tip within 40 s, a new tip after 41 s, and no repeat for the same part. (3) The report card tip is now motivational (motivate_high/mid/low). No tip_term or glossary line appears on the report. 'After' lines show the weakest-stat tip plus go_next or improve_retry as expected. (4) Weak spots: the report and review both show weak-spots with items weak-spot-0..2. Trial items are labelled 'Sentence k:' (1-based). Draft rounds show review-weak-<partId> amber borders (3 parts on Primary). Old attempts return weakSpots [] with no errors. (5) Certificate: CR6 shows a Silver 'II' 'Anuvad Nipun' badge on the right. A new player with only the Trial title gets Bronze 'I'. With no title there is no badge. The page fits A4 landscape (1123x794, no overflow, no overlap). (6) Manager: the players list shows the highest badge next to the name. The player drawer shows level cards with badges (grey locked for Secondary/Pro, not won) and the header 'MEASURES (Q/G/TC)'. Overview uses Translation Quality / Glossary Usage / Timeliness & Completion. Settings shows weights 55/25/20 and Save works ('Saved and audited'). (7) Regression: Trial start→type (Roman→xlit)→reload keeps the text→submit→report works. The 12 h session cookie works. iter12 regression passes. BUGS: the held-title motivational line is wrong ('0 wins the title'), there is a float marks_short ('9.600000000000001 more marks'), and weak-spot marks in draft rounds don't match the gain-based Translation Quality.

critical.issue: The motivate_mid line is chosen from sel.titleEarned, which uses the best score. When a title is already held, a lower re-attempt is told '<score> wins the title'. Reproduced: CR6 attempt fe904098 (score 23.4) gets 'Good job, QA! 23.4 wins the title…'. qa.cr13a Trial chance 3 (score 0) gets 'Good job, TEST_QA! 0 wins the title…'. The spec says title won (33–75) means this attempt's score is 33–75.

minor.issue: marks_short is not rounded: 'You need 9.600000000000001 more marks for the title' (qa.cr13a Primary 4de2ecd7, score 23.4, passMark 33). Round it to 1 decimal in game.ts vars (marks_short = Math.round((passMark - best)*10)/10).

In draft rounds, Translation Quality is scored as the gain over the BHASHINI draft, but weak-spot lostMarks are computed from absolute similarity to the reference. Example: an untouched Primary draft gets TQ 0/55, but the box lists only −0.6/−0.5/−0.5 marks. An untouched Pro draft (TQ 0) shows no box at all. The box is misleading for Primary/Secondary/Pro.
Numeric table parts can become the top weak spot. Secondary p59_02 'Steel Plants Year 2017-18 … Desired Actual…' was flagged. Consider skipping table/numeric-heavy parts.

ui_bugs.issue: The table overflows the drawer horizontally; the Signals column is clipped at 1920px
Step percentages are relative to the previous step, so with all-open unlock they exceed 100% ('Played Primary 10 · 500%', 'Played Professional 8 · 133%')

issues: 'N% reviewed' is completion-based (prog.done/total), not scroll-based. After scrolling to the bottom it still showed 5%. This is fine if intended, but the label suggests scroll progress.
The hinted-parts memory is a useRef, so it resets on reload and the same part can be hinted again.
Glossary data can give contextually wrong hints: for 'Fe content in iron ore' it suggested 'Content' → 'अन्तर्वस्तु'.
The page title and subtitle both read 'Your translation'.
The weak-spots side box is not sticky, so it scrolls out of view while the player reads the highlighted parts.
The badge is absolutely positioned (right:20mm; top:44mm) beside a centred name/office block. A very long name or office line could run under the badge. Consider reserving the right column.

action_items: game.ts report(): choose the motivational line from this attempt's score. Use score>=75 → motivate_high, score>=passMark → motivate_mid, else motivate_low (or a 'title is safe, best counts' variant when the title is held). Never say '<score> wins the title' when score < passMark.
Round marks_short (and any other derived numeric vars) to 1 decimal before filling Sahayika lines.
Make weakSpots lostMarks consistent with gain-based TQ in draft rounds (e.g. weight by the gain shortfall vs the draft), so an untouched draft does not show near-zero losses while TQ is 0/55.
Optional: skip numeric/table parts in weakSpots; fix the manager drawer table overflow; cap or relabel funnel percentages.
critical_code_review_comments: apps/api/src/game.ts:304: the tip uses sel.titleEarned (best-based) for motivate_mid. This is the root cause of the held-title bug.
apps/api/src/game.ts vars.marks_short = Math.max(0, passMark - best) has no rounding, which causes float artefacts.
apps/api/src/game.ts:232: tipLine still supports the tip_term kind. It is no longer used for the report (correct), but it is dead code for the report path.

apps/web/src/screens/Round.tsx glossary-hint effect: the deps are only [focusedPart], and `answers`/`view` are read from a stale closure. This is OK for a first focus but the effect does not re-evaluate if the term is typed later. The hinted set is not persisted (sessionStorage is used for `said` but not for `hinted`).
The PUT /admin/config/settings body replaces the whole 'settings' override (no merge). The UI always sends full values, so this is fine, but partial API calls would wipe other overrides.

success_rate.backend: 90% (9/10 iter13 tests; 1 failure = held-title motivational line bug)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows render and work; 1 copy bug visible on the report card + minor design items)

rca of the issue: Held-title line: reportCardLines().titleEarned = best >= passMark (it means 'title held'). game.ts reuses it to pick motivate_mid, whose text says '{score} wins the title'. Repro: sign in as qa.cr6, GET /api/attempts/fe904098-fc6e-45a2-9a74-fddac94860bf/report → tip.en 'Good job, QA! 23.4 wins the title…'. Fix: branch on a.score against passMark. Float: marks_short = 33 - 23.4 = 9.600000000000001 in JS; round it.
